Interactive Summary｜Carotid Space Imaging

Carotid Body Tumor
不要誤認為 thyroid mass 或 retropharyngeal LN

這篇研究的實用重點：位置在 carotid bifurcation，通常強烈不均質顯影，常推移或包埋 external carotid artery；大型病例需主動尋找 skull base、petro-occipital fissure、tympanic bulla 與 cranial cavity 侵犯。

5/16Boston terriers
12/14strong heterogeneous CT enhancement
6/16basilar skull affected
3/16cranial cavity invasion
Take-home判讀流程DataPitfallsFiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

Location

centered at carotid bifurcation；小型病例可見 internal/external carotid splaying。

Enhancement

通常強烈且不均質顯影；MRI 在 T1W/T2W 可相對肌肉高訊號。

Vascular clue

external carotid artery displacement / entrapment 是很重要的定位線索。

Staging target

必須看 skull base、petro-occipital fissure、tympanic bulla、cranial cavity、veins、regional nodes。

影像判讀流程

  1. 定位腫塊中心：是否 centered at carotid bifurcation，而非 thyroid gland 或 medial retropharyngeal lymph node？
  2. 追蹤 carotid arteries：是否有 external carotid artery lateral / ventrolateral displacement、entrapment 或 encasement？
  3. 找正常 thyroid glands：顯影前 CT 中 thyroid glands 應位於較後方且呈高衰減。
  4. 評估顯影：是否強烈、不均質顯影，內部是否有低衰減區或出血／礦物化。
  5. 評估 cranial extension：petro-occipital fissure、tympanic bulla、jugular foramen、cranial cavity 是否受侵犯。
  6. 評估 surgical / radiation planning：靜脈侵犯、淋巴結、神經症狀對應與 local invasion extent。

研究資料互動摘要

ItemDataMeaning
Total dogs1614 CT；2 MRI。
Most common breedBoston terrier 5/16符合 brachycephalic predisposition 的既有印象。
Sex / age10 male castrated；median 9 years中老年公犬較多。
Reasons for imagingpalpable cervical mass、dyspnea/stertor、Horner's syndrome、cranial nerve signs症狀常由腫塊壓迫或 skull base / bulla extension 解釋。
  • 大多位於 carotid bifurcation 或向其 cranial 延伸。
  • CT：多為 iso- to hypoattenuating to muscle；12/14 強烈不均質顯影。
  • MRI：2/2 相對肌肉 T1W/T2W 高訊號，且強烈不均質顯影。
  • 形狀：oval、spherical、irregular 皆可見；10/16 well marginated，6/16 poorly marginated。
FindingFrequencyImplication
Adjacent invasion9/16常見局部侵襲性。
Basilar skull affected6/16需完整掃描 skull base。
External carotid artery entrapped7/16關鍵血管徵象與手術風險。
Internal jugular vein invasion3/16可能 tumor thrombosis。
Cranial cavity invasion3/16可解釋神經症狀與預後。
  • 誤判為 thyroid carcinoma：需要在 precontrast CT 找正常 thyroid glands。
  • 誤判為 medial retropharyngeal lymphadenopathy：大型腫瘤可把 node 推移或壓迫。
  • cytology 顯示 neuroendocrine tumor 時，仍需用位置與影像特徵定義 carotid body origin。
  • 若有 Horner's syndrome / facial paralysis / dysphagia，應特別檢查 petro-occipital fissure、tympanic bulla、jugular foramen 與 cranial cavity。

Interpretation Pitfalls

最常見誤判

carotid body tumor 可被誤認為 thyroid tumor 或 neoplastic medial retropharyngeal lymph node。關鍵是腫塊中心是否位於 carotid bifurcation，以及正常 thyroid glands / lymph nodes 是否可被辨識或被推移。

支持 carotid body tumor

carotid bifurcation epicenter、ECA displacement、strong heterogeneous enhancement。

支持 thyroid tumor

腫塊源自 thyroid gland 位置，正常 thyroid gland 不可分辨或被腫瘤取代。

支持 lymph node

典型 medial retropharyngeal node 位置與形態，且非 centered at carotid bifurcation。

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 - Small carotid body tumor at the carotid bifurcation

中文：犬左側小型 carotid body tumor 的顯影後 CT 影像。A 為軟組織窗 dorsal oblique reformatted image；B 為腫塊（M）水平的橫切影像。腫塊位於 carotid bifurcation，將 external carotid artery（arrowhead）與 internal carotid artery（arrow）分開。

English: Postcontrast CT images in a dog showing a small carotid body tumor on the left side. (A) Dorsal oblique reformatted image in a soft tissue window. (B) Transverse image at the level of the mass (M). The mass (M) is seen at the carotid bifurcation, splaying the external carotid artery (arrowhead) and the internal carotid artery (arrow).

Fig. 2 - Small, large, and poorly marginated carotid body masses

中文：A，犬顯影後橫切 CT 顯示小型、邊界清楚且強烈顯影的 carotid mass。B，另一犬顯影後橫切 CT 顯示大型、邊界清楚且強烈顯影的 carotid mass。C 與 D，顯影前（C）與顯影後（D）CT 顯示大型、邊界不清的 carotid body mass。所有影像的標記：黑箭頭 = external carotid artery；白箭頭 = carotid body tumor；* = mandibular salivary glands。

English: (A) Postcontrast transverse CT image in a dog showing a small, well marginated, strongly enhancing carotid mass; (B) Postcontrast transverse CT image in a dog showing a large, well marginated, strongly enhancing carotid mass; (C and D) Precontrast (C) and postcontrast (D) CT images of a large, poorly marginated carotid body mass. For all images the following legend applies: Black arrow = external carotid artery; white arrow: carotid body tumor; * = mandibular salivary glands.

Fig. 3 - MRI appearance of right- and left-sided carotid body tumors

中文：每一列為不同犬的 carotid body tumor MRI 影像：上列為右側腫瘤（A、B、C），下列為左側腫瘤（D、E、F）。影像分別為 T2-weighted（A、D）、T1-weighted precontrast（B、E）及 T1-weighted postcontrast（C、F）。所有影像標記：大白箭頭 = carotid body tumor；小白箭頭 = external carotid artery；* = mandibular salivary gland。這些 carotid body tumors 在所有序列中相對肌肉呈高訊號，且強烈顯影。

English: Each row corresponds to MRI images at the level of a carotid body tumor on the right side (A, B, C) and on the left side (D, E, F) in two different dogs. Images are T2-weighted (A, D), T1-weighted precontrast (B, E), and T1-weighted postcontrast (C, F). The following legend applies to all images; large white arrow = carotid body tumor; small white arrow: external carotid artery; * = mandibular salivary gland. The carotid body tumors are hyperintense to the muscles on all series and strongly contrast enhancing.

Fig. 4 - Gradient-echo MRI hemorrhagic foci

中文：犬左側 carotid body tumor 的 gradient-echo 橫切影像。腫瘤內可見多發低訊號灶，符合出血；白箭頭 = carotid body tumor；* = mandibular salivary gland。

English: Gradient-echo transverse image of a left-sided carotid body tumor (white arrow) in a dog showing numerous hypointense foci consistent with hemorrhage. * = mandibular salivary gland.

Fig. 5 - Right-sided invasive carotid body tumor with skull base and bulla involvement

中文：犬右側侵襲性 carotid body tumor。A，鼓室泡水平顯影前 CT 骨窗影像，顯示因腫瘤延伸造成右 petro-occipital fissure 增寬（arrowhead），右 tympanic bulla 內側壁變薄與溶解（小黑箭頭），且腫瘤組織延伸至右 tympanic bulla 與右 external ear canal（*）。B，同一犬、鼓室泡後方的顯影後 CT 軟組織窗影像，顯示邊界不清、強烈且不均質顯影的 carotid body mass（M）。

English: Invasive carotid body tumor in a dog on the right side. (A) Precontrast CT image in a bone window at the level of the tympanic bullae showing widening of the right petro-occipital fissure due to tumor extension (arrowhead), thinning, and lysis of the medial wall of the right tympanic bulla (small black arrow) with neoplastic tissue extending into the right tympanic bulla and right external ear canal (*). (B) Postcontrast CT image in the same dog in a soft tissue window caudal to the tympanic bullae showing the poorly marginated, strongly and heterogeneously contrast-enhancing carotid body mass (M).

Fig. 6 - Serial CT images showing petro-occipital fissure, bulla, and cranial cavity extension

中文：左側 carotid body tumor 犬的顯影後連續橫切 CT 影像（A 到 D：由後至前）。A，不均質顯影腫塊（M）可見，並將左 external carotid artery（小黑箭頭）向外腹側推移；黑色 arrowhead 指示右 carotid artery。B，可見顯影腫瘤組織向左 petro-occipital fissure 延伸，該 fissure 增寬（白箭頭）；顯影組織沿左側小腦腹外側緣分布（黑箭頭）。C，左 tympanic bulla（黑色 arrowhead）內充滿顯影腫瘤組織。D，顯影組織位於顱腔腹側緣（黑箭頭）。

English: Postcontrast, serial transverse images (A to D: caudal to rostral) in a dog with a left sided carotid body tumor. (A) The heterogeneously enhancing mass is visible (M) displacing the left external carotid artery (small black arrow) latero ventrally. The black arrowhead indicates the right carotid artery. (B) Extension of the enhancing neoplastic tissue is seen toward the left petro-occipital fissure, which is widened (white arrow). Enhancing tissue is seen along the left ventro-lateral margin of the cerebellum (black arrows). (C) The left tympanic bulla (black arrowhead) is filled with enhancing neoplastic tissue. (D) Enhancing tissue is seen along the ventral margin of the cranial cavity (black arrow).

Fig. 7 - Large invasive left carotid body paraganglioma with petro-occipital extension

中文：犬左 carotid body 的大型、邊界不清且不均質顯影腫塊。A 為 dorsal oblique maximum intensity projection（MIP）；B 為顯影後橫切軟組織窗；C 為顯影前橫切骨窗。MIP 影像（A）中，腫塊（M）向 carotid bifurcation 前方延伸，並將左 external carotid artery 向外側推移（LECA）。黑箭頭標示右 carotid bifurcation；* 標示 mandibular salivary glands。B，可見顯影腫瘤組織沿左小腦腹側面進入顱腔（黑色 arrowhead）。C，可見左 petro-occipital fissure 增寬及左 tympanic bulla 內側壁溶解（白箭頭）。

English: CT images in a dog with a large, poorly marginated, heterogeneously contrast-enhancing mass in the left carotid body; (A) Dorsal oblique maximum intensity projection (MIP), (B) transverse postcontrast image, in a soft tissue window, and (C) transverse precontrast image in a bone window. On the dorsal MIP (A), the mass (M) is seen to extend cranial to the carotid body bifurcation and displaces the left external carotid artery laterally (LECA). The right carotid bifurcation is indicated by the black arrow; the asterisks (*) indicates the mandibular salivary glands. In (B), one can see extension of enhancing neoplastic tissue into the brain cavity along the left ventral aspect of the cerebellum (black arrowhead). In (C), widening of the left petro-occipital fissure and lysis of the medial wall of the left tympanic bulla is noted (white arrow).

Fig. 8 - Stalk of enhancing tissue toward petro-occipital fissure

中文：犬右側大型 carotid body paraganglioma（M）的顯影後 CT 影像。A，可見右 external carotid artery 向腹外側推移（黑色 arrowhead），與左 carotid artery（白色 arrowhead）比較。B，腫塊（M）伸出一條顯影組織 stalk，朝向右 petro-occipital fissure。

English: Postcontrast CT images in a dog with a right-sided large carotid body paraganglioma (M). In A, ventro-lateral displacement of the right external carotid artery is seen (black arrowhead) compared to the left carotid artery (white arrowhead). In B, the mass (M) is seen to send a stalk of enhancing tissue toward the right petro-occipital fissure.

Fig. 9 - Venous invasion and tumor thrombosis

中文：兩隻不同犬的 carotid body tumors 合併靜脈侵犯時之顯影後橫切影像。A，internal jugular vein（黑箭頭）擴張，且腔內充滿不均質物質，符合 tumor thrombosis；黑色 arrowhead 標示左 carotid artery。B，maxillary vein（V）明顯擴張，且腔內充滿不均質軟組織物質；可見 carotid body mass（M），並包繞右 external carotid artery（白箭頭）。

English: Transverse postcontrast images in two different dogs with carotid body tumors that had venous invasion. In A, the internal jugular vein (black arrow) is dilated and filled with heterogeneous material, consistent with tumor thrombosis; the black arrowhead indicates the left carotid artery. In B, the maxillary vein (V) is markedly distended and filled with heterogeneous soft tissue material; the carotid body mass is seen (M) and has encased the right external carotid artery (white arrow).

Fig. 10 - Common interpretation pitfalls: thyroid tumor and medial retropharyngeal lymph node

中文：兩個初次被誤判的例子：carotid body tumor 起初分別被解讀為 thyroid tumor（A）與 neoplastic medial retropharyngeal lymph node（B）。A，右側 carotid body paraganglioma 犬的顯影前橫切 CT；腫塊後緣可見（M），右 thyroid gland 位於腫塊內側，因含碘而呈高衰減。B，犬顯影後 CT 的 dorsal reconstruction；右 medial retropharyngeal lymph node（白箭頭）被 carotid body mass（m）向後方與外側推移。左 medial retropharyngeal lymph node 位於正常位置（黑色 arrowhead）。

English: Two examples where the carotid body tumor was misinterpreted initially for a thyroid tumor (A) and a neoplastic medial retropharyngeal lymph node (B). (A) Transverse CT image before contrast administration in a dog with a right-sided carotid body paraganglioma; the caudal edge of the mass is visible (M) and the right thyroid gland was visible medial to the mass, appearing hyperattenuating due to its iodine content. (B) Dorsal reconstruction of a postcontrast CT examination in a dog. The right medial retropharyngeal lymph node (white arrow) is seen displaced caudally and laterally by the carotid body mass (m). The left medial retropharyngeal lymph node is visible in a normal location (black arrowhead).

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

Strongly and heterogeneously enhancing carotid-space mass centered at the carotid bifurcation, most consistent with a carotid body paraganglioma. External carotid artery displacement/entrapment and skull base extension should be specifically described for staging and treatment planning.

Report checklist

描述：side、size、carotid bifurcation relationship、external carotid artery entrapment、internal carotid artery visibility、jugular vein invasion、petro-occipital fissure、tympanic bulla、cranial cavity、regional lymph nodes、thyroid glands 是否正常。
